initial_query: A field in a Pydantic header parameter model has an explicit alias containing an underscore, such as Field(alias="X_Custom"), but requests using X_Custom are rejected while X-Custom is accepted. Explicit aliases should be matched exactly; underscore-to-hyphen conversion should remain available for implicit model field names. Fix this without accepting previously unknown header spellings or breaking Header(convert_underscores=False).

feedback_by_state.primary: The explicitly declared header alias is still being normalized instead of matched exactly.
feedback_by_state.edge: Implicit header field names no longer get the normal underscore-to-hyphen conversion fallback.
feedback_by_state.exception: The fix now accepts a hyphenated spelling that was never explicitly registered as the alias.
feedback_by_state.regression: Headers declared with convert_underscores=False no longer preserve their original underscore spelling.

success_condition: All hidden grader states pass: primary, edge, exception, regression.
